summary.es: Reloj mundial con la hora y la temperatura de cualquier ciudad, alarmas y planificador de reuniones entre husos horarios. Web instalable con arquitectura MVVM y diseño Liquid Glass.
summary.en: World clock showing the time and temperature of any city, with alarms and a meeting planner across time zones. Installable web app with an MVVM architecture and Liquid Glass design.

summary.es: Sistema de gestión de garantías de equipos de cómputo: consulta automáticamente la API de Dell TechDirect a partir del número de serie y avisa de las coberturas por vencer. Incluye solicitudes de soporte, avisos en tiempo real e informes en PDF.
summary.en: Warranty management system for computer equipment: it queries the Dell TechDirect API from each serial number and flags coverage about to expire. Includes support requests, real-time alerts and PDF reports.

summary.en: Digital menu for a pasta and pizza restaurant in Villa El Salvador: categorised menu, the venue's story, location and an assistant that answers questions about the dishes. ASP.NET Core 10 with React, deployed on AWS.

summary.en: Personal savings goals app: users set targets and track their progress. Flutter Web against an ASP.NET Core 8 API with PostgreSQL.
